top_signals.title: Smart: Lot of Issues Off the Table in US-China Talks
top_signals.summary: US & China have agreed to extend their trade-war truce by two months. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced the deal as Chinese President Xi Jinping begins his first state visit to Washington in 11 years. Christopher Smart, founder and managing partner of the Arbroath Group spoke to Bloomberg’s Jennifer Zabasajja on Horizons Middle East & Africa about the significance of the visit. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: India’s Biggest Stock Exchange Finally Goes Public
top_signals.summary: After nearly a decade of waiting, India’s National Stock Exchange has finally gone public. But can NSE live up to years of hype and investor expectations? Rajesh Mascarenhas explains what’s behind the long-awaited debut. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Imperial Oil Becomes First Major Alberta Energy Company to Oppose Separatism
top_signals.summary: Imperial Oil chief executive John Whelan has stated his opposition to Alberta separatism, making this the first major energy company in the province to take a public position on the movement, Financial Post reported, citing Bloomberg.  "As a national company, we believe a united Canada is the strongest position we can take to face the challenges and opportunities ahead," Whelan told a Calgary conference, adding that "Canada and Alberta work best when people, products, energy and investment can move freely and reliably across the country." …
